definitions.explanation: To call out to someone to get their attention, or to summon someone.
To ask someone to come to an event or gathering.
To refer to someone or something by a particular name.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}を{呼|よ}んでください。
{友達|ともだち}を{家|いえ}に{呼|よ}びました。
examples.english: I invited my friend to my house.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}を{何|なん}と{呼|よ}びますか。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xを{呼|よ}ぶ (call X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {呼|よ}んでいる = 'is calling.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・タクシーを{呼|よ}ぶ (call a taxi)
・{医者|いしゃ}を{呼|よ}ぶ (call a doctor)
・{友達|ともだち}を{呼|よ}ぶ (invite a friend)
・{名前|なまえ}で{呼|よ}ぶ (call by name)

Godan verb: te-form {呼|よ}んで. Versatile verb for summoning, inviting, and naming.
